safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions shoulder pain on movement but does not document shoulder tingling/numbness (hpi-004).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness can reduce localization accuracy (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus involvement vs more distal entrapment), which may influence the diagnostic workup and counseling. However, the core neurologic complaint (progressive left arm numbness/tingling with some weakness) is still captured, so the impact is limited.
